dogecoin.text: There is zero justification for Dogecoin’s price. It’s not Bitcoin or Ethereum, it started off as a joke cryptocurrency and almost anyone can mine it.
Incredibly dangerous. This Dogecoin bubble is going to end in tears for many of its participants.

@mattysino Elon Musk got really lucky that Tesla’s stock soared after his 420 stunt. Once Dogecoin implodes (and it will), a lot of people including the SEC aren’t going to tolerate his bullshit anymore. At least when he is wrecking Tesla, he is wrecking his own fortune.
